stock_info.description: Fetch current market data for NSE stock: {symbol}. Call the 'Get NSE Stock Quote' tool with symbol='{symbol}'. Output ONLY the raw JSON string returned by the tool. Do not add any explanation, commentary, or markdown formatting.
stock_info.expected_output: JSON with: symbol, company_name, current_price, change_pct, market_cap_cr, pe_ratio, eps, 52w_high, 52w_low, sector, industry, about, and prices_by_exchange when both NSE and BSE quotes are available.

research.description: Get financial ratios and fundamentals for NSE stock: {symbol}. Call the 'Get Screener.in Fundamentals' tool with symbol='{symbol}'. Output ONLY the raw JSON string returned by the tool. Do not add any explanation, commentary, or markdown formatting.
research.expected_output: JSON with: symbol, ratios (dict of metric name to value), about (description).

news.description: Find the latest news for: {symbol} NSE India stock latest news. Call the 'Get Latest Stock News' tool with query='{symbol} NSE India stock latest news'. Output ONLY the raw JSON string returned by the tool. Do not add any explanation, commentary, or markdown formatting.
news.expected_output: JSON with 'articles' list; each item: title, description, source, published_at, url.
